_about: SERIES SHELF: the American-Scandinavian Foundation's Scandinavian Classics (New York, 1914 onward), translations of Old Norse, Danish, Norwegian and Swedish books, for the volumes no other shelf holds: Brodeur's Prose Edda (1916), two Bjørnson volumes, Almqvist's Sara Videbeck and Hallström's stories. Bellows's Poetic Edda, Holberg, Strindberg's Master Olof, Jacobsen, Lie, Sigurjónsson and the translators with their own shelves (Stork, Hollander, Björkman, Hanna Larsen) are shelved elsewhere. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 89); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Bare 'payne' and 'palmer' are left out: other shelves (John Payne's among them) claim them.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
